figures.finding: The actors' agreement sets all-inclusive gross minimums per shooting day by group: €1,100 for leads (group 1), €850 for supporting and series regulars (group 2) and €650 for all other speaking parts (group 3), with lower tiers for long series, very long series and low-budget works, and a floor of €325 a day for any industrial production.

value.unit: EUR gross per shooting day (giornata di posa), all-inclusive

longSeries.definition: at least 8 episodes of 50 minutes, from the 8th shooting day

veryLongSeries.definition: more than 40 episodes of 25 minutes per season

lowBudget.definition: first and second films and films under EUR 2,000,000, shorts under EUR 750,000, documentaries and docufiction under EUR 500,000 per hour, research and training works (D.L. 70/2021)

figures.applies: Italy, CCNL G140 (and its artisan twin G139), shooting days from 1 March 2024 to 28 February 2027; the rates carry no annual step.

figures.finding: Actors are represented by the confederal unions that sign the agreements, chiefly SLC-CGIL (whose statute names actors among its members and which keeps an actors' section) with FISTEL-CISL and UILCOM-UIL; membership is free under the Constitution and the agreements apply by role, not by card, and CGIL membership is joined by signing a payroll deduction form at work or at any Camera del Lavoro, costing as a rule under 1% of pay.

Per iscriversi è sufficiente rivolgersi sul luogo di lavoro ai rappresentanti sindacali CGIL, chiedendo di firmare la delega d’adesione. Oppure vai in una Camera del Lavoro, Patronato INCA, nei Centri di assistenza fiscale (CAAF), Uffici Vertenze o presso le Leghe del Sindacato Pensionati Italiani.
La tessera della CGIL si paga con trattenuta sindacale in busta paga calcolata con diversi fattori. In linea di massima è meno dell’1% della tua busta paga.

La formulazione della piattaforma rivendicativa è stata il prodotto di un complesso lavoro collettivo che ha coinvolto attrici ed attori iscritti e ,nella fase iniziale, anche non iscritti al sindacato.
